result.instructions: Tools for Vero, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a Vero profile for customer 1042 with plan=pro and timezone -7."; "Track a 'Viewed pricing' event for jane@example.com."; "Unsubscribe customer 1042 from all Vero email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vero data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vero_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vero_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vero_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vero_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vero_identify_user
tools.title: Create or update a Vero user
tools.description: Create a customer profile in Vero, or update the properties of an existing one. Sets custom properties in `data`. Vero keeps the newest value per property. Set `update_only` to change only existing profiles. Do not send sensitive data (for example passwords, card or health data). Track API: POST /users/track.

id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (the `id` in Vero).

data.description: Custom user properties as key/value pairs. Use `timezone` (integer) for the offset, not here.

timezone.description: GMT offset in whole hours, for example -7.

update_only.description: When true, update an existing profile and do not create a new one.

annotations.title: Create or update a Vero user

tools.name: vero_track_event
tools.title: Track a Vero event
tools.description: Record one event for a customer, for example a purchase or a page view. Vero creates the profile if it does not exist. Vero drops an exact repeat (same name, data and customer) within 5 minutes. Event data values must be strings. Do not send sensitive data. Track API: POST /events/track.

id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (the `id` in Vero).

event_name.description: Event name, for example `Viewed product`. Vero treats capitals, spaces and underscores as the same.

data.description: Event properties as string key/value pairs.

tools.name: vero_unsubscribe_user
tools.title: Unsubscribe a Vero user
tools.description: Unsubscribe a customer from all Vero email. This stops marketing and campaign email to them. Use it when the customer asks to stop email. The tools in this server do not resubscribe. Track API: POST /users/unsubscribe.

id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (the `id` in Vero).

tools.name: vero_edit_user_tags
tools.title: Add or remove Vero tags
tools.description: Add tags to, or remove tags from, a customer profile. Tags group customers for segments and campaigns. Give at least one tag in `add` or `remove`. Track API: PUT /users/tags/edit.

id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (the `id` in Vero).
